description: Swietlisty Rycerz, a radiant knight of heaven come down out of holy light: a tall knight in gleaming white and silver plate armour with pale gold trim, white light pouring from the joints of the armour, a closed silver helmet with a glowing white visor slit and no face visible, a thin ring of golden light above the helmet, a short white cloak, a long sword of white and pale ice-blue holy flame raised in one gauntlet, a white kite shield with a golden sun on the other arm, noble and powerful, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view facing right, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, the knight alone, no ground, no rocks, no clouds, no background, the whole figure and the whole sword inside the picture
